text: Listen in such a way that your interlocutor wants to tell you more. Learn to listen not while waiting for your turn to speak, but with maximum interest in the interlocutor, immersing yourself in the flow of their words, meanings, values... into the flow of their life. First of all, stop your urge to say something, look into their eyes, and listen not only to the words but also to the intonations, pauses, emotions. People are drawn to those with whom they feel heard. Travel through the “worlds” of the people that life brings you together with — it is infinitely interesting!
